title: Sometimes the Model doth preach: Quantifying Religious Bias in Open LLMs through Demographic Analysis in Asian Nations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with Pew Research Center survey questions regarding religious beliefs, identity, and tolerance, computing the Hamming Distance between model responses and actual survey respondents to determine religious alignment, and evaluating zero-shot steering by explicitly instructing models to adopt specific religious personas.

Profiling models by calculating the Hamming Distance between LLM survey responses and human respondent data to identify the model's dominant, homogenized persona across interconnected demographic variables such as age, gender, education level, income, caste, marital status, and urbanicity/region.
